measured.definition: lane-ops retired by the tile (the sum of the per-cycle retire count over the 64 lanes) divided by the clock cycles from the first to the last cycle with a retirement (inclusive) of each rate case, as counted by both checkers on the vehicle build at L = 3; the minimum over the rate cases is reported.  This window INCLUDES the per-K-block overhead (admission, drain, handshake), so it is the tile's rate, not the lane's.  kblock_cycles_*: cycles the sequencer's kblock_active was high per K-block (from the start pulse to the AND of the eight done pulses), measured; issue_cycles_per_block_ideal = rows x cols_per_lane x ceil(128 / g) from the geometry; overhead_cycles_per_block = measured mean minus ideal
